_comment: Scenarios for the ports evolver (ports_app.py, ports_evolve.py): the lab's parts and rules (docs/design/energy-ports-2026-11.md). silhouette: a file in samples/. level: parts up to that level. allow: part ids it may use (empty: all). budget: credits (the lab's first-guess costs). points: build points (1 a cell below level 10, 1.6 below 24, 2.5 above; the core is free). start_parts: [type, x, y, rot, flip] placed on the start (the right half and centre line). power_s: seconds of the power phase. fire: {on, off} seconds (no off: held). enemy_armour: against each gun's pen (the penetration table). incoming: the hits (damage, pen, dps, from, spread, flank, max_s). seeds: one hit run each. weights: each measure against the scenario's scales (what counts as 1). Measures: damage_before_down (damage dealt, after the enemy's armour, until the core goes), sustained_dps (power phase), systems_kept, alive_s, half_s, wiring (for each unfed port, the share of its shortest path to power built with conduits pointing the right way, a conduit counting fully once power reaches it; at most 1 a port), live_conduits (still carrying power at the end of the power phase), engine_zone, thrust_to_mass. Penalties: unpowered (guns, engines and shields getting under a quarter of what they want over the power phase), blocked (guns with the ship in front, engines with it behind), no_engines, shape_off, clashes (two outs or two ins facing). effects: what each consumable effect is worth: burn, splash and mark as a share of the hit's own damage; slow and disrupt build a suppression that stretches the time between incoming hits (at most 60% fewer). Measures for the feed layer: feed_wiring (for each Combiner or feed gun with no feed, the share of its shortest path to a tank built with pipes), fx_share (the share of damage dealt by shots carrying an effect), feed_used. idle: parts doing nothing (a store or line nothing passes through, a generator wasting every line, pipes and tanks on a feed network without both a tank and a user). scales: what counts as 1 for each weighted measure (fixed, so penalties weigh the same whatever the start).

scenarios.name: Gunship: head-on fight
scenarios.about: Most hits at the nose; scored on damage dealt before going down. Starter-to-mid parts.

scenarios.name: Capital: Sunbreaker
scenarios.about: A capital ship built around a Sunbreaker at the nose: six lines of 60 to fill, heavy armour to beat (4), hard hits from the front.

scenarios.name: Raider: burn them down
scenarios.about: Against lightly armoured ships that burn well: fire is worth as much as the hit itself. Level 20, so feed parts are open to it.

scenarios.name: Siege: crack the armour
scenarios.about: Against heavy armour (4): penetration is everything. It starts with a pair of Longbarrels (pen 3) at the nose to build round; tungsten feeds and joined lines should earn their place.
